rationale: The test profile turns on ancombc, ancombc_formula, ancombc2 and ancombc2_formula. Turning them all off (ancom is already off by default) means the QIIME2_ANCOM subworkflow is never called, so all nine of its processes are removed. METADATA_ALL still runs because diversity indices are not skipped. MULTIQC must rerun because its parameter summary and collated software versions change, and SUMMARY_REPORT must rerun because its ANCOM-BC inputs become empty and it consumes the MultiQC plots.
